subject: Eval Launchpad: environment sprint plan and MAP action items
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Brooks <lena@medstreamhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Eval Launchpad: environment sprint plan and MAP action items

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move into a short eval sprint. I put together a lightweight "Eval Launchpad" plan so we can unblock environment provisioning this week. High level: 2-week hands-on eval with a short MAP that focuses on API access, org setup, and network connectivity (IP allowlist + optional VPC peering).

Quick asks to get started: 
- Confirm a single sandbox org admin (name & email) we should invite to Redwood Private.
- Confirm IP ranges for allowlist (we can also peer if preferred) — attach network doc if helpful.
- Do you want API keys scoped to a team or single account for the trial?

I attached an Eval Launchpad MAP (spreadsheet) with suggested owners and a proposed close window (target: complete by Aug 5). Below I pasted the environment checklist we usually run through.

Environment checklist (short):
- Create Redwood trial org (owner invite)
- Generate scoped API key(s) and confirm token rotation policy
- IP allowlist entries in customer firewall + optional VPC peering request
- Provision sample dataset and test prompts (we can help upload)
- Health/access verification, latency smoke tests

Next steps: if you can reply with the org admin and IP ranges today or tomorrow, Karthik will open the VPC peering request and Marissa will provision keys and a sample project.

Thanks — looking forward to a compact, results-focused eval.

—
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0219

Attachments: redwood-eval-launchpad-map.xlsx, medstream-network-requirements.pdf

From: Lena Brooks <lena@medstreamhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Eval Launchpad: environment sprint plan and MAP action items

On Wed, Jul 22, 2028 at 08:14 AM PDT Soojin Lee wrote:
> Hi Lena,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move into a short eval sprint.

Thanks — this looks good. Quick answers:
- Sandbox org admin: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medstreamhealth.com> (he manages our dev sandbox access)
- IP allowlist: 35.192.0.0/14, 34.80.0.0/13 (we'll confirm these with infra but can start the request)
- API keys: prefer team-scoped keys per project (we'll rotate via our vault)

We are open to VPC peering but will need a short security review first. I'll loop in IT Ops (cc'd) to kick off a basic checklist — expect a note from them with firewall screenshots. Our preferred completion target is Aug 7 — internal release planning pushed our deadline out a bit.

Thanks,
Lena
VP, Product | MedStream Health

Attachments referenced: medstream-network-requirements.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medstreamhealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@medstreamhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2028 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval Launchpad: environment sprint plan and MAP action items

Aaron / IT Ops — thanks for jumping in. Short plan from Redwood side so we don't block you: 
1) I'll create a VPC peering request draft (we'll need the VPC id + region + account number) and share the peering template. If you prefer just IP allowlisting for the eval, skip the peering step for now.
2) Marissa will issue two team-scoped API keys and document the scopes. Keys will be visible in the trial org and we can re-issue on rotation.
3) Security: please share the minimal answers for our standard infrastructure checklist (I put the quick checklist in the Drive link). This lets us pre-check anything that blocks peering.

Marissa — can you provision the keys and a sample project once Aaron confirms VPC/account info or the IP ranges? I'll set up the peering ticket as soon as I have VPC details.

Next milestone: environment accessible and smoke-tested by Mon Aug 1 if we get details by Fri Jul 26. Lena noted Aug 7 as a final close — we'll mark that as the outer window.

-Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medstreamhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@medstreamhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Eval Launchpad: environment sprint plan and MAP action items

Thanks team — IT Ops validated the IP ranges and we can proceed. VPC details below for peering (if you decide to open ticket):
- VPC id: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
- Account id: 987654321000
- Region: us-east-1

We prefer starting with IP allowlist for the first week and enabling peering if we need faster bulk transfers. Marissa — request team-scoped keys for project "medstream-eval", and share in a secure doc (we use HashiCorp Vault; please coordinate).

IT Ops will send the firewall screenshots and the brief security answers tomorrow AM. If you can provision keys and invite Aaron as org admin by Mon Jul 29, we should be on track for an Aug 1 smoke test and Aug 7 close.

-Aaron
Senior Engineering Manager | MedStream Health
